Checked each sub-item per chunk. No 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction anywhere. Line 22's three short sentences ('two sessions... The un-packaged... The packaged...') are a pair of appositive fragments, not an anaphora/epistrophe triple. Line 24's 'wait, stop M5, or accept' is an options list, not the targeted repeated-clause-opener tic. No abstraction-noun stacks. No verb triplets with an empty leg.
